lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns posterior to the gill region; blobs in the mid-lateral line exhibit higher pixel intensity and larger diameters than those in the dorsal or ventral extremes.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of blobs, forming a regular grid-like pattern across the visible lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A clear horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high-intensity (top) to shadow (bottom) extending from the post-cranial region toward the posterior.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Visible high-luminance blobs are distributed across the first dorsal fin, with a cluster of larger spots concentrated near the leading edge and base, and smaller, more diffuse spots toward the trailing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Contrast between the high-density micro-spotting on the rostrum/cranial section and the organized macro-spotting on the lateral flank.
